definitions.ask: Should the fix be proven green on a throwaway draft PR before it lands on master?
definitions.why: CI is the only place these tests run (the Mac lacks XCTest), and every failure landed unrun

choices.label: Iterate on a temp PR until the whole macOS job is green, then land; 10–30 min CI wait per round
Land after local gates; the next master run may expose more and need follow-up work
